`final class ResourceResolver`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.resolver` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceResolver.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/resolver/ResourceResolver.java)

The registry of resource resolvers that `Resource.of(...)` asks for inputs it cannot read itself.

## Description

It holds a [`TextureResourceResolver`](/reference/bridges/textureresourceresolver/) and a [`BufferedImageResourceResolver`](/reference/bridges/bufferedimageresourceresolver/) by default.

## Learn more

- [How Resource.of picks a resolver](/build/resource-resolvers/#how-resourceof-picks-a-resolver)
